comment: P0 scenario pack (PLAN.md 4.5): the demo lever. The marathon_season wave itself ships in goal_config.json (running shoes 5504, ticks 6-9, x4 arrivals); this pack supplies the on/off arm pair that exhibits it, and the overlay knobs (extra_waves / wave_scale) are available here for custom windows without touching goal_config.json — pack contents merge into goals.overrides, so only config_hash changes and arms stay branch-compatible.
name: marathon-season
